correctness.rationale: In truth chain {0,1/2,1}, only 1⊙1=1 and 1⊙(1/2)=(1/2)⊙1=1/2 are nonzero, so the transitive reflexive R is exactly a preorder P=R^{-1}(1) and H=R^{-1}([1/2,1]) closed under left/right P action. H is constant on P-equivalence blocks; on quotient poset Q its extra pairs form an upset of D_Q⊂Q^op×Q. Hence A_n=Σ_k S(n,k)Σ_Q u(D_Q), and chain cores correspond to Catalan staircase ideals. Independent brute-force ternary matrix enumeration yields 1,9,281 for n=1,2,3. Independent poset+upset enumeration yields T1..T4=1,8,256,27434 and thus A4=29027. Finite tests corroborate, while the general bijection supplies proof.
residual_risks: Exactly three truth grades, labelled finite nonempty sets, not arbitrary fuzzy relation levels.
